Manual_Notes: Same retrospective evidence base as encorafenib (PMID 31658370). Solo BM data sparse. Combination evidence in S4 combo override.
No published iORR. Dedicated trial enrolling: NCT05840770. Grade D = consensus extrapolation from anti-PD-1 class.
No published iORR. STARLET trial (NCT05700721) ongoing, est. completion 2029. Grade D = consensus extrapolation.
LUX-Lung 3+6 pooled BM analysis (Schuler JCO 2016, PMID 26823294): CNS ORR 72.9%, CNS PFS 8.2 mo. CNS was secondary endpoint -> Grade B.
ALEX trial (Peters NEJM 2017, PMID 28586729): CNS ORR 81% in patients with BM by BICR. Prespecified CNS endpoint -> Grade A.
Only case report of complete remission in RCC BM (PMC9626359). No formal iORR cohort with adequate sample size. Downgraded C->D.
ALTA-1L trial (Camidge NEJM 2018, PMID 30280668): intracranial ORR 78% by BICR in patients with BM. Prespecified CNS endpoint -> Grade A.

Multi-center retrospective (PMID 34673916, n=88, 15 institutions, JAMA Oncol 2021): iORR 55% (95%CI 36-73%) in progressing BM without local therapy; 47% with concomitant local therapy. Tier corrected from 20-39% to 40-59%. Grade C (retrospective). NCCN category 2A also supports consensus point.
iORR values from combination regimens (CMF/FEC breast BM, cyclophosphamide-based SCLC BM). No solo CNS data exists. Grade D reflects post hoc combination evidence only.
No solo BM monotherapy iORR data. Combination evidence (66.7% SPEED trial) moved to S4 combo override. Pooled meta <20% for durvalumab alone. Class 1 retained via consensus point only.
Holbrook 2020 retrospective case series (PMID 31658370), encorafenib +/- binimetinib in melanoma BM. Combination evidence (70.8%) is in S4 combo override (E-BRAIN, PMID 38946469).
CTONG-0803 phase II (Zhu Ann Oncol 2013, PMID 23129122): 82.4% PR in EGFR-mutant NSCLC BM. CNS secondary endpoint -> Grade B.
Carboplatin+etoposide 33% iORR lung BM (PMID 8643223); cisplatin+etoposide 37% (PMID 8395873). Combination regimens for SCLC/GCT, prospective. Also receives NCCN consensus point.
59% Zotero value (item 6EMYM55E) from combination chemotherapy study in breast cancer BM, not solo fluorouracil. No monotherapy CNS data. Downgraded C->D.

Margolin Lancet Oncol 2012 (PMID 22735750): arm A (10 mg/kg, asymptomatic, no steroids) iORR 24% in melanoma BM. Arm B with steroids: 0%. Best single-cohort iORR 24% -> tier 20-39%. Combination in S4 combo override.
Solo iORR 6.3% phase II glioma (PMID 19066728). Values 60%/28%/37% in prior table were bev+irinotecan combination data — excluded. V3 scoring corrected to class 0.
iORR 20%/23% from Zotero are lenvatinib+pembrolizumab combination data (RCC BM). No solo lenvatinib CNS study exists.
ABC trial nivolumab monotherapy arm (Long Lancet Oncol 2018, PMID 29602646): iORR 20.9% in melanoma BM. Combination arm in S4 combo override.

CORRECTED: V3 assigned pts_iORR=1 based on 36% PFS-6 from OPARATIC (PMID 32347934) — misidentified as iORR. Actual iORR=0% from phase II IDH-mutant glioma (PMID 36968138, n=15, best response SD only). No consensus point. Total score 0 -> Class 0. Removed from CNS-active list. V3 scoring update required.
FLAURA CNS subgroup analysis (Reungwetwattana JAMA Oncol 2018, PMID 30153097): 91% measurable CNS ORR. Prespecified CNS endpoint -> Grade A.
Goldberg JAMA Oncol 2016 (PMID 27213832): KEYNOTE melanoma BM cohort, iORR 26%. Prospective cohort with standardized IC assessment -> Grade B.
Bailon Ann Oncol 2009 (PMID 19632738): 28% PR in 39 NSCLC BM patients with pemetrexed. Other series 38%. Tier 40-59% reflects higher estimates in regimen combinations. Grade B.
Primary CNS tumors (GBM/FGFR-altered), not brain mets; FIGHT-207 CNS cohort

Dirven 2024 paper found is combination (regorafenib+BRAF/MEK inhibitors, IC-ORR 29%). Solo regorafenib 20% claim in V3 code unconfirmed from available literature. Downgraded C->D pending solo study verification.
LIBRETTO-001 CNS cohort (Drilon JCO 2022, PMID 34088726): 85% iORR in RET+ NSCLC with BM. Dedicated CNS expansion cohort -> Grade A.
Phase II SCLC BM (PMID 12175688): iORR 33%. NCCN SCLC CNS progression standard. Prospective cohort -> Grade B.
No dedicated solo BM trial. iORR 58% is from COMBI-MB (dabrafenib+trametinib combination, PMID 28592387), not solo trametinib. Tier 1 assigned as conservative extrapolation from combination. Grade D.
DESTINY-Breast12 (Jerusalem Nat Med 2024, PMID 39271844): 71.7% measurable CNS iORR in HER2+ breast BM. Prespecified CNS primary endpoint -> Grade A.
STARTRK-2 and pooled analysis (Doebele Lancet Oncol 2020, PMID 32534626): 62.5% measurable CNS iORR in NTRK+ solid tumors. Prespecified CNS cohort -> Grade A.

Phase 0 window-of-opportunity trial (PMID 39112464, NCT03995706, n=25 BCBM+rGBM): iORR 38% in BCBM cohort; intracranial SN-38 concentrations confirmed. Upgraded C->B (prospective trial with defined intracranial endpoint). ASCENT stable-BM subgroup iORR 3% excluded (inactive CNS disease).
IV rituximab monotherapy in relapsed/refractory PCNSL (PMID 21383331): ORR 36%. Primary CNS lymphoma = CNS-specific disease. Also NCCN PCNSL standard (HD-MTX+rituximab). Grade B.

iORR 36% from pediatric low-grade glioma phase II (Zotero 4VUEGU8Y); 25% from cisplatin+vinblastine+TMZ combination in melanoma. Neither represents adult BM monotherapy. CSF levels low (PMID 6678966). Grade D.
CNS responses confounded by concurrent brain radiotherapy; not isolable drug signal

V3 assigned tier >=60% but primary source is amivantamab+lazertinib phase 2 (PMID 41139066): iORR 40% BM. Solo lazertinib CNS mono data not independently confirmed at >=60%. Flag for V3 tier review (possible downgrade from >=60% to 40-59%).
Only case report exists (PMID 33224000, ribociclib+anastrozole). No formal iORR cohort. Downgraded C->D.
DeLLphi-300 update; 62.5% volumetric shrinkage excluded (not iORR); 42% ORR excluded (fragile, not iORR-specific)

Prospective dedicated BM trial (NCT02308020, n=58): iORR 5.2% -> tier <20%. Real-world PMID 39419769 (Tarlton 2024): iORR 45.1% but 80.5% had prior brain RT/surgery; CNS responses not attributable to abemaciclib alone. Class 2 retained using real-world data with caveat; Grade C. Both datasets noted for transparency.
CROWN trial CNS analysis (Solomon JCO 2022, PMID 35605188): 82% measurable CNS iORR by BICR. Prespecified CNS endpoint -> Grade A.

Retrospective pooled IC ORR ~35% (PMID 25624436). ASCO-SNO-ASTRO guidelines explicitly recommend against crizotinib for ALK+ NSCLC BM in favor of alectinib/brigatinib. Grade D reflects guideline exclusion despite retrospective signal.
